tools.name: z2h_search_marketplace
tools.description: Find live software by keyword before building from scratch. Public, no sign-in needed. Returns descriptions, USD license prices, tech stacks and listing links. Example: {"search": "invoice", "limit": 5}. Empty search browses recent software. When hasMore is true without nextCursor, narrow the search

tools.name: z2h_create_draft_listing
tools.description: Create an invisible draft and return editUrl and publishUrl. Price and source inclusion are Builder decisions. tools.name: z2h_list_my_listings
tools.description: Find the authenticated Builder's drafts and live listings before creating another draft. Requires listings:read. Returns items with slugs, publication state, USD prices, edit links, and nextCursor. Pass nextCursor to continue paging; null ends the list. An invalid or expired token requires sign-in a

tools.name: z2h_get_listing
tools.description: Read one owned listing before editing it. Requires listings:read. Use a slug from z2h_list_my_listings. tools.name: z2h_update_draft_listing
tools.description: Update an owned draft. Omitted fields stay unchanged; nullable fields accept null to clear them. Live listings cannot be edited through this tool. Requires listings:write. Returns the draft identity and web edit/review links. On conflict, read the listing again before retrying.

tools.name: z2h_request_source_upload
tools.description: For an owned draft, get a short-lived signed archive URL. Ask the Builder to explicitly accept this exact statement: "I own or have the rights to sell the codebase I am about to upload." Pass ownershipAccepted=true and ownershipVersion=2026-09-27 only after they accept. Returns signedUrl for the arc

tools.name: z2h_confirm_source_upload
tools.description: After the signed PUT succeeds, verify and attach the archive to the owned draft. Confirm that the Builder accepted "I own or have the rights to sell the codebase I am about to upload."; pass ownershipAccepted=true and ownershipVersion=2026-09-27. tools.name: z2h_compare_marketplace_listings
tools.description: Compare a shortlist of public software from marketplace search. Returns current public descriptions, USD license prices, types and tech stacks. Unavailable software is omitted without disclosing its status. This tool cannot purchase software or access private source.

tools.name: z2h_show_marketplace
tools.description: Show public software cards and an interactive comparison panel. Without slugs, shows the newest live software. Prices and availability

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: z2h_create_draft_listing, z2h_update_draft_listing, z2h_request_source_upload · Private data: z2h_list_my_listings, z2h_request_source_upload, z2h_confirm_source_upload, z2h_compare_marketplace_listings · Public sink: z2h_request_source_upload, z2h_confirm_source_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: z2h_create_draft_listing, z2h_update_draft_listing, z2h_request_source_upload · Private data: z2h_list_my_listings, z2h_request_source_upload, z2h_confirm_source_upload, z2h_compare_marketplace_listings · Public sink: z2h_request_source_upload, z2h_confirm_source_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
